features.title: 同一分支在多条真实前驱路径后的学习各自保留，选择性纠错不污染其他历史
features.description: 真实前驱路径建立独立学习，工作集越过旁路周转或达到长表容量后仍保留。只为选定路径提供真实NT结果，使其公开预测越过目标条件分支选择兜底；未选路径仍选择原条件分支。重访全部混合方向身份后，只恢复选定路径，最终再次检查所有公开预测及原始metadata。内部计数和位置仅为附加完整性检查，不单独构成功能完成。

contract.event: 同一窗口依次经历多条真实前驱路径，建立多个预测身份，随后在其他身份学习及选择性错误反馈后重新消费。
contract.owner: 方向和保护属于逻辑分支位置、完整tag与其原始路径；读索引历史、tag历史和当前token历史分别拥有，不能用当前状态代替原来源。
contract.effect: 受保护短历史不冒充另一分支；只反转选定历史的预测方向，其他历史仍为T。全部历史公开消费者可区分T/NT归属，随后选定历史独立恢复方向及保护。
contract.observation: 独立账本在驱动前规划方向反转所需的真实反馈。公开预测及metadata分别证明选取目标条件分支或真实兜底，完整自主模型另外比较来源、保护和方向状态；晚些时候重新消费全部历史。
contract.preservation: 局部反馈不能改变其他历史；独立确认的全局维护可按共同前态降低保护，但保留方向、完整身份和原始快照。容量内不能因旁路周转丢失已学习身份。
contract.scope: 32与512历史的有界真实路径程序；容量场景交叉检查既有051维护语义及两种方向的新消费者。不豁免高tag失败，不声称所有地址、全部维护并发或完整FTQ已验证。

short_path_retention_evidence.scope: 补充七/十五条真实前驱的短表NT学习保留、选定路径奖励和实际SRAM；不替代旧长表选择性反转及全局维护合同。

short_mixed_direction_evidence.scope: 十五条真实来路超过八项旁路容量，混合方向、选定NT到T到NT、全部幸存者和三个阶段实际SRAM；不替代既有长表合同。

semantic_requirements: 多条真实前驱路径的索引、tag和token历史各有准确来源
旁路周转或容量内的历史身份继续独立保留
只使选定路径的公开方向转为NT，其他路径的公开预测仍为T

合法全局维护后保留方向和身份，新的T/NT消费者及最终全部居民仍正确

features.title: 从复位起禁用的预测来源不能覆盖其他活跃来源的正确结果
features.description: 来源从首次查询前就被禁用，另一来源正常初始化与学习。禁用模块的未初始化保持结果不能参与有效选择，真实Main学习和新消费者仍保持正确。与先冷查询后禁用的对照分别报告。

contract.scope: 这两类冷启动隔离边界，不宣称任意在途CSR切换、完整FTQ或全部预测器组合。

features.title: 自然分支工作集保留各自学习，选择性方向纠错与新身份替换互不污染

features.title: 旧预测恢复自己的循环迭代上下文，不继承年轻预测已饱和的状态
features.description: 正常学习形成向后条件循环，每个预测从独立语义模型取得不可变迭代快照。保留真实旧来源，再使年轻预测自然到达255并暂停。旧来源的向后taken条件恢复只对自己的原计数加一并饱和；向前条件、不跳条件、向后直接跳均结束循环上下文。原来源已为255时恢复保持255而不回绕。比较每拍注册状态、各有效流水级的原快照、实际恢复输入、同拍新查找和后续公开metadata消费者；原metadata不变。IMLI与条件GHR/BW和延迟历史窗口选择分开，不将原INT043/094明确排除的IMLI继承为已验证，不声称完整FTQ或全部预测器组合。

contract.event: 真实旧条件预测被保留，年轻预测反复执行向后循环至饱和，随后旧来源发生恢复。
contract.owner: 循环迭代快照属于准确的原预测身份；相同编码、相同PC或当前全局计数不能替代原来源。
contract.effect: 仅taken向后条件分支延伸原循环并在255饱和；其余结果清零；恢复优先于年轻预测更新。
contract.observation: 独立流水线选择和迭代模型先预测，再核对memory-direct只读状态、实际公开恢复接纳、查找输入、注册结果及新metadata。
contract.preservation: 暂停无分支事件时状态保持，旧预测的两个公开快照不随年轻执行或恢复而修改。
contract.scope: 自主Micro/Main/PHR和IMLI及受控Main/TAGE末级方向分歧的有界公开输入；低20位半字地址后向语义、8位饱和；不包含任意延迟GHR/BW查找、SC索引或完整FTQ合法性。

向前条件、不跳条件及向后直接跳都结束循环，而非仅凭目标后向继续计数。
原来源已饱和时恢复保持255，不回绕且不以相同编码替代准确来源身份。
暂停、实际恢复、查找、注册状态和新公开消费者全部比较后，才授予checked覆盖。
正常学习弱负provider和相反的taken base，真实S3方向修正从自己的快照重建迭代，新查找的准确身份到达公开消费者。
两个不同真实原预测按年轻到更老顺序连续接纳恢复时，第二份更老来源仍存活；比较中间及最终历史、原迭代、完整输入与新公开消费者，禁止年轻前缀复活、合并两份结果或借用当前计数。

features.title: 已被替换的旧分支迟到学习时，按原身份重新建立完整记录而不继承占位者计数
features.description: 正常预测保存旧分支 A、B 的独立来源，随后 A 迁移而 B 已失去驻留。B 的迟到 taken 反馈以自己的旧计数 5 重新建立 6，不能命中占据原目的地的 A=0 并错误得到 1。另一已饱和 A 的旧结果不产生写；无关邻居保持。另用不同原来源先使 A=0 形成待写版本，再由后到 B 完整替换，旧待写义务明确终止；最后以另一份旧 A=2 来源重新建立 A=1，保留 B=6。实际接纳、完整提案、阻挡期间旧存储消费者、精确 SDK 服务、新消费者和原快照联合核对。不同周期的确定替换，不规定同拍同目的地竞争优先级，也不把部分分支有效输入当成完整 FTQ 已完成。

contract.owner: 重新学习属于旧原分支的完整逻辑键和原计数，不属于当前位置的另一分支或新计数。
contract.effect: 按旧来源建立完整新记录并替换同目的地旧身份；被替换的待写义务终止，先后重建的其他身份保持。
contract.observation: 独立正常准备、真实原接纳和完整提案、阻挡前后消费者以及恰好最新完整 SDK 服务共同比较。
contract.preservation: 未被替换的邻居、其他已重建身份、原始 metadata 和饱和不产生写的另一分支保持。
contract.scope: 有界公开训练输入的单目的地及先后替换；不声明同拍同目的地仲裁或完整 FTQ 存活资格。

semantic_requirements: 失去驻留的 B 以原 5 学习到 6，不能继承当前占位 A 的 0；另一原 A 和当前 A 均饱和时不得虚构 A 写。
先前 A 待写而后到 B 替换同一目的地时，只服务 B 的完整结果；该确定先后替换不被扩大为任意容量无损。
B 已重新建立后，另一份真实旧 A 独自重新建立 A=1，B=6 和所有未受影响身份保持，两个历史均有完整消费者。

features.title: Guarded RAS rollback reclaims cancelled call versions and preserves live identities across bounded-storage reuse
features.description: The independent persistent RAS program model observes real integrated call/return events and owns frames, repetition groups and retirement from reset. Fill speculative capacity with normally learned repeated old-address calls and require extra real call/return offers plus same-current checkpoint recovery to leave the guarded prefix unchanged. Restore a genuine older source below the guard threshold, consume old returns, cancel only a younger return and retire the surviving old calls/returns in order. A distinct newly learned call identity must then allocate chronological versions across bounded-storage wrap, reusing cancelled and retired storage without losing live ancestry. Cancel only its youngest call, retire all kept new calls exactly once, then fresh real returns must consume the new return address and preserve the old retained groups. All actual S3 sources and input/output comparisons are associated, original metadata remains immutable, and checked coverage waits for full closure. This is a RAS semantic component cut point with independently checked genuine public consumers and retirement, not autonomous MainBTB/all-predictor or complete FTQ legality. No fabricated pointers, internal writes, VPI, case edge/task/gather or slot/bank/set sweep. The bounded-storage lifetime requirement complements rather than duplicates standalone010 shallow guard/rollback recovery. 以还留一组空间和恰好保留全部调用两种容量边界，交叉外层次数更多和内层次数更多；逐笔比较完整返回PC/目标、各层退休后的完整提交状态及最终sentinel。 近容量调用目标修正取消年轻后缀并只重做原调用一次，不能串用相邻递归层计数，也不能丢失仍存活的外层调用。 仅覆盖声明的容量内逻辑调用树；不返回已淘汰调用，不按栈槽枚举，不外推任意深度或完整FTQ执行。

contract.effect: 恢复只取消年轻后缀；回收空间可被新身份复用，存活版本可按序退休一次。

contract.scope: 集成RAS语义切点；不宣称任意FTQ调度或所有预测器组合合法。 仅覆盖声明的容量内逻辑调用树；不返回已淘汰调用，不按栈槽枚举，不外推任意深度或完整FTQ执行。

features.title: 同一分支的完整修正版本相互取代，但独立方向效果不被合并丢失
features.description: 两个原真实预测相邻修正同一MainBTB分支，之后已服务的该身份再次接受fresh修正。 类型、位置、tag及完整目标组成一个分支版本；方向反馈是独立的有序义务。 待写记录只保留最新完整版本，两个方向效果均服务；fresh修正能重新激活已服务身份。 预先声明不同类型/区域目标，核实实际提案、一次最新完整记录服务及两次方向服务，再比较全部fresh消费者。 较晚同块sibling、独立受保护身份和原快照保持，中间已被取代目标不得服务。 自主Micro/Main/历史的同记录修正与clean再激活；不外推任意容量冲突或完整FTQ/预测器组合。

semantic_review.previous_title: Same-record MainBTB corrections supersede complete pending versions and reactivate a clean committed owner
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Autonomous Micro/Main/history models normally learn an earlier negative conditional and a later indirect sibling in two protected contexts. Two different genuine old predictions at one PC correct the earlier misclassified branch to taken indirect targets on adjacent public inputs beside continuous same-bank predictions. Declare complete type/position/tag/carry/target effects before driving. The same logical record must retain only its latest complete pending version on its original owner, while the separate direction FIFO retains BOTH actual source effects without drops. A fresh consumer must still see the old complete record before read release. SDK monitors then require exactly one latest-entry service and two masked direction services; no intermediate target may service. A fresh consumer sees the corrected kind and next-region target. Correct that exact fresh clean owner to a previous-region target, require one reactivated complete service and its own direction update, then a fresh complete consumer. Preserve the later sibling, unrelated protected row and all immutable original metadata. Reached/checked credit waits for actual events and full closure, not a driver plan or model-only transition. No actual state seeds, internal writes, VPI, case edge/task/gather, bank/set sweep, capacity-loss waiver or complete all-predictor/FTQ claim.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 完整记录版本和方向队列有不同合并语义；仅检查最终目标不能证明两个方向来源均已接纳。

semantic_requirements: 同一间接分支的两个原始发生按真实接纳顺序更新，不能按预测年龄或当拍metadata重绑定。
年轻先解析与年老先解析分别跨实际已服务/自然读优先保留；未执行后继的弱不跳/强不跳方向均保持。
完整输入、被动服务和两个fresh独立消费者闭合后才记录checked；不通过bank/set遍历补证明。
旧cold来源必须在年轻来源学习期间始终有效，不能借用早期恢复锚点后仍发送已冲刷原件。

features.description: 两个真实历史的原方向来源相邻反馈，同时连续预测读阻挡写回。 两个相反方向但各自正确的旧预测反馈，在部分结果已写入而其他结果待写时相邻到达。 补充原提示均处于内部区间的双分支正确反馈，按相反顺序及相邻/第一笔实际成熟后发送。 每个等待服务版本属于原历史/provider，原快照与最新待写计数不能混用。 各身份按自己的已接纳反馈累计，服务前消费者仍见旧存储，服务后分别见正确新值。 两笔学习分别作用于各自当前分支版本，不能以原饱和提示丢掉会改变当前计数的效果，也不能覆盖另一笔待写义务。 较晚分支的NT反馈必须保留较早实际NT前缀，当前值饱和保持也不能省去已经实际接纳的完整提案义务。 自主Main/TAGE/历史建立不同来源；实际相邻接纳、阻挡、SDK服务顺序及两历史fresh消费者闭环。 交叉正后负/负后正和两个原来源各自的内部/饱和边界，逐笔比较原提案、当前归属、全部服务与四阶段十二个fresh消费者。 原快照、独立邻居及全部四个服务义务保持，不靠暂停读取伪造并行。 无关历史、未提供结果的后继、邻分支待写和原始metadata保持。 原提示2/2由正常学习和真实查询建立；另一历史的待写学习、原metadata和四阶段消费者保持。 声明的容量安全两历史方向程序；不外推全FTQ nonce/epoch或其他预测器组合。 新双反馈程序仍是BPU预测器组件切点；原值和前缀正确性不是完整FTQ年龄/恢复取消/后端可达性证明，不把保存快照当作FTQ学习资格。 另一分支未反馈或原预测与当前值均已饱和免写时，首分支合格的旧原件在当前下界仍保留独立服务义务；真实来路分别有容量余量或占满保留容量，并区分尚待写回和已经服务后重新学习。反向改变、恢复和其他来路均由新消费者核对。 较晚分支原taken计数5的旧结果，在当前上界7仍保留独立服务；前面的分支缺席或明确给出正确且饱和NT前缀时都不能吞掉后继。反向NT和恢复taken必须保留实际完整NT前缀。

semantic_review.previous_title: Interleaved non-reread learning preserves both branch owners in two histories under continuous read priority until four exact commits
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Autonomous history/MainBTB/TAGE state establishes opposite strong providers in two genuine history paths at one PC. Capture distinct A/B/A/B old reads, each with counters 2/5. A learned same-bank loop keeps reads uninterrupted while four complete NT-prefix/T-tail feedback beats accept on adjacent cycles alongside public predictions, without TAGE rereads. Independently retain four logical pending versions, compare blocked full write-port fronts and zero ready, and require a new consumer in EACH history to still see old SRAM counters 2/5. Release reads only after both old-value consumers. SDK ReadyValidMonitors must confirm two correctly ordered writes per owner, preserving row/tag identity and composed counters 0/7; new consumers in BOTH original histories then verify all four commits and complete repair windows. Six reached/checked obligations, no fixed waits, state-seeded golden, internal write, physical bank/set sweep or RTL change. Full FTQ nonce/epoch and other predictor combinations remain outside this profile.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 原计数与新值预先区分；单看driver完成或模型队列清空不足以证明真实SRAM服务。

semantic_requirements: 单路旧反馈先占用一个逻辑结果，再接纳邻历史和重新建立的另一分支，使两路服务次序对应不同历史。
后续两笔原快照反馈分别更新各自当前身份，保留独立邻居，不把同拍或同序号的两路输出关联成同一来源。
服务前后分别比较原历史、邻历史和被替换历史；四个完整服务、五个不可变来源和全部消费者闭合后才计入已检查。
两路先服务不同历史的结果后，新消费者应逐分支观察已服务和未服务的混合版本，不能把一段历史当作原子提交。
旧来源对已服务饱和结果可重新提出学习，新真实饱和来源则抑制写；两者均须保留另一身份的待写累计，不以相同末值混淆服务义务。
部分服务后的旧目标和旧邻居反馈相邻接纳，各自重新激活干净结果并累计待写结果；原快照和全部无关历史保持。
两路剩余结果数量不同时，独立比较完整身份、次序及实际服务数，缺失或额外服务均失败；四阶段真实消费者闭合后才计入已检查。
不同正常预测年代的正确taken和not-taken结果在迁移后迟到，应分别从当前0和待写6反向学习，不以原提案6或1覆盖当前结果，也不伪造错误反馈的不重读资格。
原来源已处于7或0饱和端但当前保留计数已改变时，仍须按当前状态处理其真实正确结果；原提案不变不能替代当前学习义务。
两份不同来源的正确正向与负向反馈相邻接纳，当前0先到1再回0；第二来源为此前捕获的下界0时也不能漏掉返回0的更新，原邻历史及未提供的分支结果保持。
多份不同且原本预测正确的未饱和来源迟到，当前累计学习应到达上下界并保持，不能反复安装旧提案、回绕或遗漏邻历史的待写结果；逐笔实际可服务结果须与独立预期一致。
积压结果到达并保持饱和后，另一批不同真实来源的相反正确结果应从当前边界反向累计至另一边界；最后完整服务及四阶段新鲜消费者比较前，不把相同末值或纯模型演算当作checked覆盖。
迟到训练必须仍能重建该原预测的路径历史；分别检验持续taken读流与不推进路径历史的fall-through读流，历史已失存活资格时保留失败和首错，不能将错误row/tag归为TAGE置信累计错误。
同份反馈的后继缺席或自身已正确饱和免写，不能吞掉首分支未饱和旧原件的独立学习资格；当前值饱和保持仍需比较真实完整提案及恰好一次服务。
有容量余量与占满保留容量时分别检验待写版本、已服务版本上的旧原件保持；反向学习后恢复，所有其他来路和未参与分支保持。
较晚分支旧原件仍有资格而当前已到上界时，前面的正确饱和NT结果只免除自己的写入，不取消后继服务；前缀未提供只属于部分反馈，不视作已执行证明。
较晚分支反向NT与恢复taken均必须接纳并比较实际完整NT前缀，其他来路和先前首分支程序保持；不能只交换物理输入端口冒称前缀验证。

semantic_review.previous_title: Opposed branch-owned directions distinguish raw fast and qualified final provider selection

The order requires separate strictly ordered accepted taken conditional misses, not planned labels or already-known branch updates. Independently compare all defined TAGE component outputs/metadata and exact public source association; require the raw later provider to cause an S2 repair, but the weak qualified provider to yield to the NT base and cause an S3 repair. Strengthen only the later branch, require the S2 result to survive S3, and preserve its owner and the earlier neighbor. Compare the entire causal override window, rejecting wrong-PC/target/tick, missing and extra repairs including same-target extras. Each discovery history has its own five reached/checked hardware event rules, all four groups required in publication. No new functional ID for adding the missing discovery prerequisite, random-state observation, internal writes, fabricated metadata, fixed settling delay, bank/set sweep or RTL change. semantic_review.previous_title: Independent same-cycle writes preserve retained owners across hit/miss companion states
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Capture genuine NT/T highest-table predictions in one transaction, then use normal feedback and read pressure to cross four banks, four shadow depths and eight modes: ordinary/crossed retained owners with pending/clean replay; port0 miss with dirty/clean companion hit; port0 retained hit or already-saturated hit with companion first miss. Freeze complete input metadata, all-bank active/inactive write payloads, qualified initial shadows and complete resident profiles before driving. A bounded independent two-write reference resolves both requests from the same pre-cycle state, applies drain once and preserves both updates; reject selected-slot collisions, duplicate keys and full-row-miss PLRU rather than invent priority. Static Bundle/@on Monitors and direct Scoreboard compare exact accepted inputs, four-cycle write latency, every full shadow transition and hand-derived owner/depth/hit/counter witnesses. Existing asynchronous prediction Scoreboard checks overlapped forward/reverse complete profiles and sentinel pressure cadence. A miss initializes from its request counter even when an unrelated old slot is seven; hits forward retained counters through both saturation ends. Close 384 bank/depth/mode/phase bins only after all comparisons. Standalone zero-history MiniConfig contract, not integrated FTQ qualification, collision/full-row PLRU reference, useful-defect fix or full TAGE verification.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: advance_tage_shadow_writes本身是缓冲组件切点，不能单独证明父输入合法；case的真实捕获、默认TageReference与完整消费者检查需同时保留。

semantic_review.previous_title: Captured request way preserves retained owner and depth during counter forwarding
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Capture genuine highest-table counter-5 metadata before normal tag migration to the other way. Across four physical banks, both original ways, four retained depths and pending/clean operation, use normal same-bank prediction pressure to prepare destination ownership without internal writes or full-row overflow. Replay correct-taken old-way feedback with taken base prediction, isolating counter ownership from useful updates: request counter remains six while the retained counter independently advances 5->6, 6->7 and holds at seven. Freeze full sparse input, all-bank active/inactive write payloads and full public profiles before driving. Passive Bundle/@on Monitors check accepted feedback, exact four-cycle input-to-write latency, every shadow cycle, drain priority, unique owner/depth and all unchanged slots. Existing asynchronous prediction Scoreboard checks forward/reverse full target and neighbor profiles with one-cycle acceptance cadence and two-cycle completion latency. Close 192 bank/origin/depth/mode/phase bins only after checks. Standalone upper-saturation/zero-history contract; no lower saturation, full-miss PLRU, useful-defect fix or integrated FTQ qualification claim.

semantic_review.previous_title: Mixed-feedback overlap forwards counters and saturates; separated feedback rereads SRAM
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Prepare four same-bank contexts, both highest-table target ways and NT counter 1/2 with saturated useful. Capture two genuine predictions before any feedback, each with an earlier NT target and a different later cold taken allocation in resolve slots 0/7. Adjacent feedback must preserve two same-old-read dual-write requests and buffer-forward the target twice, saturating at zero; separated feedback must reread current SRAM state, decrement again from counter one or suppress a saturated target write, despite the captured metadata still carrying the old counter. Independent references are frozen before driving; driver/feedback monitor check exact input identity and adjacent versus write-drained cadence, all-bank read-only Bundle/Monitor checks per-event write payloads and four-cycle latency, existing asynchronous prediction Scoreboard checks counter/useful/way/full metadata, final newcomer, disappearance of both old victims and all six protected neighbors using forward and reverse overlapped readback. Close 96 context/way/counter/mode/phase bins only after checks. This is a standalone feedback-port contract; no full FTQ trajectory, allocator or shadow-capacity claim.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 等待时间只是协议调度，判据必须是实际服务/读取，而非等了足够多周期。

semantic_review.previous_title: Same-event counter update and cold allocation across both highest-table ways
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Prepare four same-bank contexts with every tagged cell protected except one highest-table way. With either way as the resident target and real counter 1/2, resolve an earlier not-taken target and a later cold taken branch in sparse resolve slots 0/7. Independent pre-drive expectations require target counter decrement, a weak-positive allocation in the other way, old-victim disappearance and six protected residents intact. An agent-owned read-only static Bundle/Monitor captures all highest-table bank/way writes in one event; direct Scoreboard checks beat count, active and inactive ports, exact set/tag/counter/valid/outcome and input-to-write latency. Existing asynchronous prediction Scoreboard checks complete metadata and overlapping forward/reverse readback with acceptance/completion cadence. Close 48 context/way/counter/phase bins after checks, without exposing edges or native calls. No claim of full allocation/history/FTQ or multiple-shadow-slot equivalence.

semantic_review.previous_title: Saturated and unqualified providers do not masquerade as parallel writes
semantic_review.scenario_detail: For four same-bank contexts and either highest-table way, resolve a cold taken allocation beside a saturated NT/useful target, a target without MBTB matching, or an inactive target. Require exactly one allocation write, unchanged target state, victim disappearance and all protected residents preserved. Global-disable cases require zero writes and complete retention after re-enable, including the old victim and a cold newcomer. Independent expectations and passive same-event all-bank/way observation distinguish legitimate no-op from missing/extra writes; independently checked sparse input metadata and asynchronous pipeline readback retain context and timing. Close 96 context/way/reason/phase bins only after assertions. This is a standalone feedback-port contract, not proof of program FTQ reachability or a full TAGE reference.

semantic_review.previous_title: Exact alternate/provider state across prediction slots and confidence buckets
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use genuine normal allocations to establish a table3 provider above a protected table2 alternate. An independent pair model predicts every taken/useful counter and both selector buckets before feedback, including selected alternate updates, strong-provider-only updates, saturation/hold, wrong provider, qualification/enable gates, selector reentry and weak-alternate confidence crossing. Agent-owned optional read-only Bundle/Monitor samples full hit masks, per-way table counters/useful values and the actual selected alternate counter in the same clocked observation as public prediction. The existing asynchronous Scoreboard checks paired results in all four prediction slots and both base confidence values; independent input observation checks sparse resolve placement and unchanged real metadata. Close 224 direction/slot/base-confidence/phase cross bins only after exact checks. No post-update DUT counter seeds the model, internal writes, testcase edge/VPI calls or complete-program FTQ reachability claim.

semantic_review.previous_title: Mixed protected resident and alternate context retain same-event pipelined association
semantic_review.scenario_detail: In both outcome directions, make the pair provider strong while a protected earlier resident retains the opposite direction. Submit repeated MainBTB vectors with the target in prediction slots 1/2/3 beside that resident, interleave forward and reverse layouts without asyncio.gather, and drain through the existing prediction Scoreboard. Close twelve direction/slot/order cross bins after assertions. Agent-owned same-event state binding has bounded scope and restores the basic decoder; capability errors must fail explicitly rather than skip. This is a standalone pipeline contract, not a complete TAGE or FTQ reference.

semantic_review.previous_title: Threshold custom bounds reject the whole aggregate and recover in every way
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use genuine prediction metadata and normal feedback with an independent threshold model and agent-owned read-only Bundle/Monitor. Reach both inclusive bounds 640/5040 with one qualifying branch in each way, check four rejected attempts per way and inward recovery. Separately use four distinct conditional branches hashing to each same way: 642 minus four and 5038 plus four must retain the old value rather than saturate to 640/5040, and inward four-step recovery must remain possible. Compare the complete four-way vector after every feedback; verify other ways stay at reset state in the single-target cases. Sample 24 boundary/way/phase bins in each of two groups only after checks. The current four-way MinimalConfig and picker address units are explicit; these are standalone feedback-port contracts, not full-program FTQ traces. No fabricated metadata or internal state writes.

semantic_review.previous_title: Threshold eligibility, mixed-direction aggregation and adjacent accepted feedback
semantic_review.scenario_detail: For each physical threshold way, independently predict the update from genuine SC metadata before driving feedback. Check wrong-SC qualification, MBTB miss, nonconditional branch, invalid TAGE provider, disabled training and genuinely high-confidence agreeing correct feedback. Check same-way net-zero, positive and negative contributions from distinct resolved branches and prediction slots, then four adjacent feedback beats using passively monitored beat count and two-tick cadence. Compare all four threshold values through the agent and require expected qualifying slots and per-way increment/decrement counts, not just matching prediction direction. Sample all forty way/reason bins only after assertions. Learned high-confidence preparation is also reference-checked per beat; no actual threshold observation seeds expected state, fabricated metadata or internal writes.

semantic_review.previous_title: History-conditioned learning and independent overlapping prediction snapshots
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Feed semantic path, global, backward and loop history contexts through public ports. Independently own all five weight families and adaptive thresholds, compute indices and sums from PC/history rather than debug indices, and compare every defined decision, confidence/bias metadata and component direction. Train opposing outcomes in representative contexts, preserving genuine source metadata; interleave six predictions without waits between launches and require source-time weight snapshots and exact context association. Invalid common history excludes global/backward learning without excluding path/loop/bias. Reached and checked coverage remain separate, reset cancels old obligations, and checked credit follows successful independent public-output comparison. No bank/set sweep, actual-memory seeding or internal writes.

Reached/checked are separate; preserve the complete physical/native denominators. One width-boundary program, no bank/set enumeration, internal writes or native state used as expected data.

features.description: MicroBTB复位完成，开始新的预测/学习执行。 已有不同类型和目标的记录，且旧项可靠性下降；在已提交、fastTrain、resolve及两来源同拍竞争时发起复位。 同PC旧响应之后的新原查询，在实际接纳后立即reset或完整响应后reset。 新请求属于复位后的寿命，旧条目与在途反馈不得成为新有效来源。 预测/训练就绪，首个真实冷查询无旧命中，后续正常taken学习可工作。 两轮新查询无旧身份或被仲裁拒绝的来源复活；新项经历两次NT仍命中、第三次失效，随后新taken正常重建。 原查询按其快照身份完成响应或由reset结束，旧同PC帧不能替代新请求；复位后仅新来源建立新分支。 实际就绪状态、独立冷态与新请求/学习消费者比较，不把reset中闲置输出当响应。 原driver接受事件、memory-direct实际学习活动、现有独立模型及完整新消费者共同证明，旧快照保持不变；到达与完整比较分开统计。 acceptance-only driver与独立源快照monitor比较实际接纳、响应/reset关系；不伪造响应handle完成。 未发送新请求时不强求未声明的lookup锁存器值，不能据此制造假失败。 独立MicroBTB四类来源复位寿命；两来源必须真实同拍，resolve优先；不外推完整系统FTQ来源证明。 不覆盖跨复位尚未完成的异步查询transfer取消。 查询仅证明声明的响应/reset结束关系，不等于通用processing响应handle取消。

semantic_review.coverage_fingerprint_20261020: 连续训练旁路的 t1_hit 限定符在记录耗尽后仍被转发，not-taken 命中时 initEntryIfNotUseful 整体重写 tag/usefulCnt=3/slot target。实际公开响应 valid=1,taken=1,target=0x80003650，即 not-taken 自带目标被安装为 taken 预测。分隔发送通过、连续发送失败，差异在转发路径。该失败保持普通 FAIL；同轮三拍相邻 taken 用例关闭 UbtbDut.v:1793 饱和保持臂。

features.title: 禁用拒绝新预测和新学习，但不删除已学分支

semantic_review.previous_title: Complete counter-address transition matrix and feedback qualification preserve all peer cells

semantic_review.scenario_detail: Exercise four banks, all 64 sets, four steered victim ways and same/different read-write sets, producing 2048 real port conflicts. Independently replay tree-PLRU from the common prestate: same-set write wins instead of sequentially merging the read update, while different sets update independently. The next real allocation proves the victim and complete public resident profiles prove target/way isolation. Read-valid is the qualified taken-hit training port, not ordinary prediction traffic; this does not claim offline capture of the public T0 input or counter-strength replay.

There are 96 discriminating priority cases; 32 feedback operations already produce 2 and are retained as non-discriminating controls, not independent priority proof. Independently check every slot's complete nine-field payload, retained-valid/dirty status and actual lowest-dirty drain through pending, dirty rewrite, drained and clean-reactivated phases; 256 bank/order/slot/phase bins are required. Public target and metadata readback verify persistence and peer isolation. features.title: Pending indirect target corrections retain distinct destinations and coalesce only the same destination
features.description: Use genuine checked metadata for two resident indirect branch positions sharing one PC/tag and one bank/row. Hold bank reads while accepting two target corrections. Before write retirement both targets remain old; afterward distinct destination updates must both survive, while two updates of one destination expose only the last target and preserve the neighbor. These are independent UT feedback inputs, not a claim of two taken indirects executing in one FTQ block. No internal slot/dirty/write packet is an oracle input, no buffer overflow is required, and no bank/set enumeration is used. Offered and independently checked semantic credit remain separate.

semantic_review.previous_title: Correctly predicted branch feedback still trains the conditional counter
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Keep a conditional entry and a second resident in one align bank. No physical equivalence proof or whole-FTQ closure is claimed.

semantic_review.previous_title: Depth-one shadow retains entry owner independently of request-way counter initialization
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use normal captured-miss feedback under 24 same-bank sentinel predictions to fill two different-set keys in depth zero and depth one of one write-buffer owner. Across four physical banks, both retained owners, clean-first versus pending-second request ordering and same-bank blocking versus opposite-bank flow, independently predict two retarget requests and owner-retaining writebacks. A passive static Bundle/Monitor proves the second key is genuinely valid and clean in depth one, then checks its exact final payload without internal writes. Input and entry Scoreboards compare full beats, request/writeback payloads, cadence and latency. A bounded independent state reference resets each allocated request-way counter to two, even for unmatched empty payloads, while entry identity remains at its owner. Forward/reverse asynchronous reads compare both complete profiles and protect the other key before 96 cross bins are credited. This standalone two-way/two-depth contract does not claim full FTQ pointer/epoch/resolve qualification, arbitrary saturated neighbors, overflow or multi-hit cleanup.

semantic_review.scenario_detail: Direct and indirect taken branches with target mispredictions must not allocate from cold metadata. Branch type is driven consistently through lookup, MainBTB training metadata, and feedback.

semantic_review.previous_title: One FTQ feedback beat updates two distinct conditional providers
semantic_review.scenario_detail: An earlier correctly predicted not-taken conditional branch and a later correctly predicted taken conditional branch share one training pulse, with a vacant resolve slot between them. Each has an independent MainBTB hit and TAGE metadata entry; both provider counters must update in opposite directions without allocation, and a second beat must advance both independently again.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 两个输出都变化比两路valid更强，但不能替代所有同拍仲裁语义。

semantic_review.previous_title: Two legal branches take two steps in one shared alternate-selector bucket
semantic_review.scenario_detail: An earlier not-taken branch and a later taken branch use distinct provider ways in the same TAGE table and selector bucket. One FTQ feedback beat contributes two selector increments while both provider counters update independently; subsequent compensating feedback distinguishes exactly two selector steps from zero, one, or three.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 旧batch验证两步阈值差，不据此宣称两端边界或任意投票数均覆盖。

每个可由公开协议构造的 (providerTable, altConf) 选择器桶都必须各自到达并保持 0/31 两端：越过端点的那一拍仍产生真实 inc 或 dec 投票，而 5 位寄存器停在端点；同一拍其余 7 个寄存器必须保持。端点期望必须来自闭式算术（弱 provider 且 provider 预测 ≠ 替代/基础预测 => ±1），不得读取 DUT 结果回填。

semantic_review.previous_title: Four same-bank pending indices retain opposite provider updates and isolated reactivation
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Prepare four distinct SRAM indices with the same highest-table provider way and strong directions opposite to their resolved outcomes. Repeat their genuine misprediction metadata in 32 adjacent feedback beats, which request SRAM reads and defer write-buffer drain without allowing longer-table allocation. Require all original cells to reach alternating counter 0/7 and correct directions. Reactivate only the first index and check its counter changes to 1 while the other three remain saturated. Reset and repeat with serial feedback as a control. Four distinct indices do not exceed buffer capacity.

semantic_review.previous_title: Dual-way training retains four pending rows, useful progress and unselected neighbors
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Populate both ways of all four tables at each of four same-bank indices using genuine prediction metadata. One legal feedback beat per index resolves the earlier highest-table branch not taken and the later one taken, updating separate write ports with exactly one real misprediction. Repeat 32 adjacent beats, then pipeline vector readback through the existing driver/monitor: original providers must reach counters 0/7, and the correct later provider's useful counter must increase in every row while the earlier useful counter holds. All six unselected branch tags per row must retain their direction, counter and metadata. Reactivate only the first earlier branch to counter 1 and require every other row/way and neighbor to hold. Reset and repeat as a serial control, comparing counters/directions without incorrectly demanding identical useful accumulation. Four distinct keys per port fit the entry buffer; no lossless duplicate-beat guarantee is imposed on the useful queue.

semantic_review.previous_title: Fresh provider feedback follows legal way migration and preserves resident neighbors
semantic_review.scenario_detail: At four same-bank indices, separately exercise highest-table way 0 to 1 and way 1 to 0 migration. Complete useful reset before capture, protect all lower-table residents, and keep both highest-table ways not useful with the opposite way strong. Capture a genuine strong-taken provider prediction, weaken that resident with a different real misprediction, replace only the weak/not-useful way, protect its new tag, and reallocate the original tag into the other way. Fresh feedback must update the current tag counter and useful state while preserving the replacement tag and all six other residents. Pipelined driver/monitor/scoreboard all-grid and forward/reverse readbacks validate metadata and accepted/completed timing. An on-demand passive monitor verifies every feedback's complete encoded payload and ready acceptance; exactly seven accepted beats occur after capture, with no intervening reset. All 120 context/direction/phase/check bins are sampled after assertions. This is a single-module scenario, not a proof of integrated FTQ scheduling reachability.

features.title: Captured provider-way feedback must not change another resident tag after migration
features.description: Repeat the independently checked eight-case migration matrix of TAGE-025 but replay the genuinely captured correct strong-taken metadata, including its old physical provider way. A stale useful update may be dropped or redirected to the current tag; it must not modify the unrelated replacement tag in the old physical way. semantic_review.previous_title: Opposite resolved outcomes cancel when two branches hash to one SC way
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Two conditional positions in the same fetch block map to one SC way but occupy separate MainBTB prediction slots. Repeated same-beat feedback with the earlier branch not taken and later branch taken must leave both cold corrections unchanged when both are qualified. A subsequent single-branch feedback must learn not-taken, and both prediction slots must observe the shared way. This tests per-way increment/decrement aggregation, not merely independent multi-way training.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 必须区分共享基础way与bias子特征；不同bias不能仅因way相同就要求抵消。

semantic_requirements: 只有完整权重特征相同的反馈才聚合；上下界净零不受输入排列影响，相同基础way但不同bias特征必须独立。
共享五家族及同一bias特征到达上下界后，来自独立真实冷原件的同拍相反教导应净零；交换原预测槽关联不改变结果。32份fresh反向教导按精确步数跨零，逐家族消费者、阈值、其他经验与原metadata必须保持各自合同。

semantic_review.previous_title: Two same-way not-taken branches aggregate a double update per feedback beat
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Reset between matched experiments with two conditional positions sharing one SC way and equal TAGE counter inputs. Compare beats to observe a not-taken SC correction when each feedback beat contains only the earlier not-taken branch versus both not-taken branches. Both slots must share the learned correction, and two-branch feedback must require fewer accepted beats. Repeat the scalar control after a third reset and require the same learning curve, excluding residual state as the cause of speedup. This distinguishes a per-way PopCount=2 update from a slot-zero-only driver.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 收敛速度是本用例区分一步/两步的证据，不是把固定周期数量定义为功能。

semantic_review.previous_title: Consecutive FTQ feedback beats merge distinct SC ways under pending writes
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Two conditional positions in one fetch block select different SC ways. Send eight qualified not-taken feedback beats without gaps, alternating prediction slots, so later writes arrive while earlier same-row writes are pending. After drain, require both ways to learn; reset and show both also learn with serially spaced feedback. Consecutive train reads can observe stale SRAM data, so the requirement is eventual two-way convergence, not identical cycle counts to serial feedback.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 旧用例主要检查最终方向与收敛；默认ScReference逐查询比较完整定义输出，但没有专属成对覆盖来分别证明全部中间保留状态和实际服务。

semantic_review.previous_title: Four same-bank pending indices learn independent opposite SC corrections
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use four distinct same-bank SRAM indices and one conditional way with alternating resolved directions. Each round sends 16 adjacent feedback beats using genuine per-PC prediction metadata; training reads hold the bank busy while updates occupy at most four pending slots. After drain all four contexts must eventually use SC and return their respective opposite directions. Reset and repeat with spaced feedback, compare cold states and learned outputs, and require serial convergence no slower than the burst. This does not assume that stale SRAM reads accumulate one independent update per beat.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 同bank是制造竞争的参数，16反馈只是刺激配方，不新增物理功能。

semantic_review.previous_title: Masked way updates preserve four pending indices and unselected learned or cold neighbor ways
semantic_review.scenario_detail: At four distinct same-bank indices, use provider counters 0/7/3/4 to expose all four real bias selectors and positions 4/5/6/7 to address all base ways. Train one branch way at a time with 16 adjacent feedback beats over only four indices. After every burst require earlier learned ways to retain their output and all later unselected ways to remain cold; each selected way must eventually use its intended SC correction. Public five-table index metadata and bias bits stay associated with each PC. Pipelined readbacks use the driver/monitor scoreboard; a reset serial control compares cold and each learned stage without assuming per-beat serial equivalence.

semantic_review.previous_title: All bias selectors merge independently inside each pending SRAM row
semantic_review.scenario_detail: At four distinct same-bank indices, cross positions 4/5/6/7 with provider counters 0/7/3/4 at every PC, exposing all sixteen bias ways within each row. Keep genuine cold metadata to train every selector negative with four-row adjacent or reset-serial feedback; after each selector update, check all selector/way bias directions through public debug metadata independently of the shared SC total sum. Capture all-negative genuine metadata, then reverse only a row/selector checkerboard of two base ways per row, requiring every unselected selector and way to retain its negative bias. Check all five table families' indices, provider counters, selector bits, SC decision/meta association, prediction acceptance and completion timing. A passive feedback monitor checks beat count, PC, selectors, resolved branches and cadence. Finish with forward/reverse overlapping prediction transfers. Sample 1280 mode/phase/row/selector/way cross bins only after assertions. Do not assume adjacent stale SRAM training reads accumulate one counter update per beat or identical serial convergence. No internal signal writes or fabricated training metadata.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 旧1280物理交叉不代表1280个语义要求，也不证明相邻旧读逐拍串行累计。

semantic_review.previous_title: Previously drained bias rows reactivate selected ways while preserving neighbors
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Prepare four same-bank indices with genuinely captured cold metadata and four-way positive feedback, using adjacent pending feedback and a reset serial setup control. Require all four selector-0 branch ways at every PC to use their learned taken SC correction. After feedback/update/drain and complete pipelined readback, capture genuine learned-positive metadata. Reactivate one existing selector-0 way at a time using spaced negative feedback, checking all sixty-four bias selector/way directions after every attempt: previously reversed ways stay negative and all untouched ways/selectors retain their direction. Capture all-negative genuine metadata, relearn only a row checkerboard of two base ways per row, and preserve every unselected negative way and other selector. Monitor actual feedback identity and cadence; overlapping driver/monitor scoreboard readbacks check index/provider/selector/decision metadata and timing, including final forward/reverse snapshots. Sample 1024 setup/phase/row/selector/way bins only after assertions. This tests pending-to-drained-shadow reactivation rather than only dirty merge or newly allocated rows; no fabricated training metadata, internal signal writes, exact signed-counter claims or per-beat serial-equivalence assumptions.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 旧1024交叉是参数保留，不能替代真实clean前提和再次服务证明。

Check each output before sampling selection bins.

semantic_review.previous_title: Full region capacity reuses existing region without corrupting packed SRAM neighbor or other target pointers
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Allocate 16 different non-PC 1 MiB target regions at distinct same-bank SRAM indices, with identical target low bits, checking every resident after every insertion. At full region capacity allocate an odd neighboring folded-SRAM lane using an existing region and a different offset; all 16 old targets and the new neighbor must survive. Interleaved reverse-order requests check pointer/history association through the driver/monitor scoreboard. No lossless guarantee is demanded for a seventeenth distinct region.

semantic_review.previous_title: Four pending target-table indices in either bank survive live reads and repeated dirty/clean-shadow updates
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Cross both SRAM banks with first-table confident providers and highest-table zero-confidence providers at four distinct indices within each buffer's capacity. Queue 16 prediction reads and submit eight adjacent feedback beats revisiting the four PCs with genuine pre-write metadata; acceptance timestamps prove actual overlap, and each in-window observation must retain its original provider state. After drain check independent confidence strengthening or target rewrites; retrain each clean shadow and verify every neighbor, including real longer-provider allocation and alternate penalty for first-table misses. Reset and repeat both modes and banks with serial feedback controls. Repeated stale metadata is not modeled as cumulative counter increments.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 重复旧metadata不是TAGE式最新计数累计；相邻输入数不能当成精确累计步数。

semantic_review.previous_title: Byte-address transactions correctly encode and decode PrunedAddr PC target and provider metadata fields

semantic_review.previous_title: Full region-table PLRU replacement redecodes only victim pointers and retains other providers
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Fill all 16 target regions, then use a real cold allocation to reuse region 0 or 15 and touch its PLRU path. Allocate two new non-PC regions at unused predictor indices. An independent heap-order tree-PLRU/address model predicts the victim before observing outputs; interleaved driver/monitor readbacks must return each pointer current region and original offset while provider identity, confidence and usefulness remain unchanged. Old references to the victim may change target region; no lossless guarantee is imposed beyond capacity. Both PLRU halves and two successive replacements are crossed with victim/survivor observations.

semantic_review.previous_title: Near-overflow guard preserves redirect metadata and recovers after rollback
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Fill the speculative queue with distinct calls until the near-overflow guard rejects a push. Repeated guarded pushes and a guarded pop must leave both the public top and redirect metadata unchanged. Redirect to an earlier saved frame to release queue capacity; a fresh push and pop must then work and preserve that frame. This tests guard-to-rollback recovery, which top-only overflow and shallow redirect tests do not establish even though RAS RTL line coverage is full.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 旧006的top拒绝与浅007不能替代此恢复链，保留全部metadata检查。

semantic_review.previous_title: Committed call frames survive speculative-queue retirement and unwind in LIFO order
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Speculate and commit three distinct calls using each branch's pre-operation commit metadata. Perform more than one speculative queue's capacity of committed temporary call/return pairs while retaining the oldest three frames, and check pointer wrap plus preserved SSP/SCTR. Three later returns, each also committed, must recover the two older addresses from the committed stack and then the initial empty top. A commit-disabled control must fail rather than pass using still-live speculative entries.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 默认RasReference从语义调用组独立维护身份，现有commit_recovery保留；仅观察指针绕回或重复当前top不足以证明存活前驱。

semantic_review.previous_title: Committed duplicate counters survive queue reuse and split at positive saturation
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Commit a distinct base frame followed by three or nine identical return addresses. The nine-call case exceeds the three-bit repeat counter maximum and must create another frame, not wrap or lose a call. Reuse more than a full speculative queue with temporary committed calls/returns, then check every repeat's return address and remaining SCTR until the distinct base and initial empty top are restored. Reset between normal and saturation controls.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 现有repeated_commit及默认语义调用组参考；固定重复次数只是穿越边界，不代表每个计数值是一个新功能。

semantic_review.previous_title: All committed stack slots preserve retained cells through repeats, queue reuse and unwind
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use ordinary ordered call/return operations and genuine pre-operation commit metadata to cross all eight committed SSP slots with normal and saturated repeat counters. An independent bounded compressed-call model retains the contents of popped physical cells and explicitly accounts for eight-slot capacity eviction. Static read-only Bundle/@on observation checks every committed cell, head, full accepted input payload, public SSP/SCTR/top and registered commit latency on every cycle. Check speculative-queue reuse and full unwind, not merely the final top. Close sixteen slot/mode bins only after comparison. Does not claim non-push bos reclamation, coroutine action semantics, full FTQ qualification or repair of the existing disable-metadata defect.

semantic_review.scenario_detail: Drive RasOperation sequences through the agent's act_many API with no idle beat between accepted operations. Require all twenty-seven named scenario bins; no asyncio gather, edge timing or internal writes in tests. Bounded speculative sequences only, not queue-full recovery, action-three semantics or integrated FTQ qualification.

semantic_review.previous_title: Redirect restores genuine inflight or committed checkpoints and redoes call or return
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Capture genuine checkpoint metadata with SCTR zero/three/seven in inflight and committed storage, then add two wrong-path calls. Recover the checkpoint and redo a same-address call, distinct positive/negative-address call or return. The agent encodes the public cfiPc byte address without losing its sign bit. An independent bounded reference checks complete redirect payload, restore/redo latency, every retained committed cell, public top/SSP/SCTR and full subsequent unwind. Close twenty-four storage/counter/redo bins after all comparisons. Ordinary call/return standalone port contract only; no fabricated neutral commits, action-three coroutine behavior, complete FTQ path or RTL defect repair claim.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 正负地址指的是地址符号区域而非允许负Python整数；24组场景不等于全部FTQ恢复合法性。

semantic_review.previous_title: Dropped call-retirement notifications exercise credit threshold, wrap, push priority and neutral reclamation
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Intentional omission of call retirement notifications, not a claim of normal FTQ legality. Preserve the six standalone real call/return profiles: same/cross epoch, distance-two hold, distance-three non-push reclamation and push priority, with all thirty-six semantic bins and no neutral action-zero in that standalone scope. Add a bounded integrated profile with genuine neutral direct-instruction S3 sources and independently owned persistent-program checkpoints: distance-two hold, guarded full-capacity neutral reclamation, registered credit update followed by guard release without intervening recovery, different-address new-call version reuse and fresh return consumption. Both profiles compare complete public metadata/top, all eight retained committed cells, head, BOS and actual registered payload/effect timing through read-only memory-direct Bundle monitors. Neutral notifications must not fabricate stack writes; ordinary call/return source ordering and SSP checks remain strict. No enable defect exploitation, fabricated pointers, internal writes, physical slot sweep or duplicate feature ID.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 独立UT的Retirement窄模型只证明正常call/return通知，拒绝中性action；BPU中性程序需自己的完整故障参考，不能把两者当同一种空操作或互相替代。

semantic_review.previous_title: Both tables retain newest counters through immediate bypass and eight-index ring wrap
semantic_review.scenario_detail: For each table and each physical bank, prepare eight distinct real prediction indices using two existing encoded PC addresses and low-four-bit folded-history profiles; keep the known tag-width regression separate. Twelve adjacent correct feedback beats to the first index must saturate its counter through immediate bypass while seven neighbors remain weak. Sixty-four adjacent beats interleaving all eight indices must retain each original provider, saturate its counter, and preserve prediction/training-history association. Reset serial control must match all three functional stages. Pipelined comparisons use only valid requested branch metadata, not unrelated invalid output slots. semantic_review.scenario_detail: Repeat all immediate-bypass and eight-index ring-wrap preconditions for both tables, all four banks and both adjacent and serial feedback. semantic_review.previous_title: Two global useful-aging rounds distinguish lower decrement from upper shift in all banks
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Prepare three distinct indices per bank with lower useful strengths 1/2/3 and upper useful 3 from genuine prediction metadata and correct/error feedback. A separate calibration source must remain allocation-blocked after two upper-provider errors and reopen only upper after the third, proving useful increment/decrement rather than assuming it from counter changes. Account for all failed allocation probes and use fresh highest-provider errors to hit exactly two 128-failure lowTick boundaries. After the first age only lower-strength-1 aliases allocate and their upper escalation remains blocked. After the second age, lower-strength-2 aliases must allocate lower before escalating, while lower-strength-3 aliases allocate upper directly and preserve their original lower provider. Pipelined all-grid readback after every operation checks counter, provider, position, bank/index and history association, including unchanged neighboring contexts and removal/retention of each original position. Ignore raw takenVec on hit=0, as required by the RTL validity contract. Sixty phase/bank/strength cross bins are sampled only after all output assertions.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 旧两轮aging矩阵及其物理交叉组保留，但不授予新同拍义务PASS。新六例DUT已PASS：正常输入建立分配/奖励/惩罚前态，128次真实无法分配按独立计划计数，末次失败与目标来源相邻接纳；实际两表维护和完整学习控制同拍，全部1024保护从共同旧值老化，所有方向层由fresh来源消费，来源各用一次且不变。不改旧专项参考的128次之前范围，不直接据此关闭集成S3/FTQ生成资格或所有物理副本。

semantic_review.previous_title: Short-history aliases preserve independent long-history providers and shared lower fallback
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Encode a consistent raw recent PHR profile using the generated MinimalConfig's sorted history/fold widths and XOR-window folding, with bound-port width checks. For older bits 6/7/8 and all four banks, keep PC/position and six-bit short history identical while the twelve-bit upper history selects distinct rows. Genuine feedback must first expose the shared lower provider, then allocate independent opposed upper providers. Adjacent correct-feedback bursts saturate A to 0 and B to 7; after every bank update pipelined all-grid reads must preserve all neighboring banks, the opposite history and a never-trained older-bit-11 context's shared lower counter 4. Forward/reverse overlapping predictions assert A0/A1 alignment, complete PHR metadata, both hash indices, provider, counter and direction. Sample 144 phase/bank/older-bit/context cross bins only after assertions. Low-four-bit profiles remain compatible; out-of-range histories fail before transfer submission.

semantic_review.previous_title: Upper hash collisions reallocate history tags and replay captured counters
semantic_review.scenario_detail: For all four upper SRAM banks, flip recent PHR bit pairs (0,9)/(1,10)/(2,11) so A/B have the same upper hash index but distinct lower indices and upper tags. Using genuine metadata, allocate upper A at counter 3/useful 2 and an independent weak upper neighbor. B initially allocates only lower; its provider error is blocked while upper A is useful, and remains blocked after one upper A error. A second error frees upper, allowing B's new tag to replace A while A falls back to unchanged lower counter 3. Correct B direction and saturate to 7 through adjacent or reset-serial feedback; a passive training monitor checks beat count, PC/index identity and cadence. Replay captured A counter-3 metadata after B is resident and require upper A counter 4, not resident B's counter; replay captured B counter-7 metadata after A is resident and require upper B counter 6. Every phase uses pipelined A/B/neighbor readback with full PHR/index/provider/counter/position association, followed by 24 mixed-order transfers. Sample 720 mode/bank/fold-pair/phase/context cross bins only after assertions. Lower writes fit eight resident slots; this is tag identity/reconstruction evidence, not SRAM-persistence proof after shadow eviction.

semantic_review.previous_title: Every useful address allocates independently under serial and adjacent feedback
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Exercise all 512 physical useful addresses in both tables using genuine cold prediction metadata and public training feedback, under reset-serial and adjacent-cycle cadence. An independent temporal reference derives the earlier useful read, delayed allocation qualifiers and three-cycle visible write from accepted transactions, then compares all 1024 useful cells at qualified write boundaries and the following cycle, including unchanged neighbors. Verify complete folded-history and index metadata, allocation direction, public readback and real resident payloads. Require all 2048 mode/table/address cross bins after comparison. Lower high-address tag-width misses remain explicitly observed prerequisites for the separate full-update requirement; allocation does not claim those providers are usable, and no internal state is written.

features.title: 合格预测反馈增减 usefulness，在边界保持且可反向恢复
features.description: 真实原provider接受奖励、惩罚、base一致反馈及保护上下界上的重复反馈，并在新来源下反向恢复。 补充真实短预测错误升入长提供者后的双完整身份奖惩及下界纠错。 两个相反方向的短历史预测分别保留自己的真实原查询。其他反馈先翻转当前方向，原来正确的预测随后返回；再让翻转期间取得的原错误预测返回，此时当前方向已再次变回。 真实原预测及原基础预测一致且正确，但其他反馈已使当前方向相反；当前保护为1时，这份迟到的原一致性反馈返回。 反馈资格及保护更新属于原查询的完整逻辑provider身份，每个原始发生只教导一次。 每份反馈只教导一次，完整索引、分支位置、匹配历史、基础预测和原预测方向均属于原始查询；保护奖惩按原预测贡献判断，方向置信度则在当前保留版本上累计。 资格属于原查询的预测、基础预测和实际结果。不得用当前方向追溯改判，也不得把方向置信度重新从原提示初始化。每份原来源只教导一次。 保护强度按贡献增减并饱和保持；保护见底不能冻结方向纠错，只有正确且有贡献的覆盖才能恢复保护，base一致不得虚增。 长提供者没有更长表可分配仍须完成学习；其初始保护及后续效果各归原身份。 目标原方向为T时，计数4→3→4→5；另一历史为NT时，计数3→4→3→2。首次翻转使保护1→0，迟到原正确反馈使0→1，迟到原错误反馈使1→0。不能用当前方向将奖励改成惩罚，也不能把错误原预测改成正确。 原一致性反馈使保护1保持1，同时方向计数4→3或3→4。随后另一份真实原贡献反馈仍恢复方向并把保护1→2，原错误反馈仍使保护2→1。 独立重放反馈资格和算术，比较真实反馈、所有学习写入、方向阈值前后并发消费者及全部保护状态。 公开异步预测transfer保存真实接纳/完成及独立原读取祖先；driver发送完整原metadata。现有memory-direct monitor比较所有学习版本和1024个保护单元；迟到发送前比较当前实际保留版本，发送后比较新消费者与合法长表伴随结果。 复用已校准的公开预测transfer、driver、独立UtageReference和完整学习monitor。返回前比较实际当前保留版本与全部保护状态；返回后必须同时比较无保护变化、确有方向学习及新消费者。 另一逻辑身份、非目标单元和已完成快照保持；合法长provider伴随分配必须被建模，不能禁用后忽略。 长提供者学习不改写既有短经验，拒绝长匹配的fresh消费者必须仍可使用原短经验。 独立历史、未反馈保护单元、合法的长历史伴随分配和所有原查询快照保持。最终短/长消费者分别消费自己的真实版本。 两个相反方向的独立历史、合法长提供者伴随分配、全部1024保护单元与原查询快照保持；最终短/长消费者各消费自己的真实版本。 独立UT的声明保护生命周期、串行及相邻反馈；不把地址矩阵当新功能，不据此声明完整FTQ或所有预测器组合已验证。 独立UT的原预测反馈切点，复用已有合法分离读取/匹配上下文；不声称完整FTQ来源寿命、物理副本等价或长表PASS能解释短表缺口。 独立UT的原来源/当前保留版本分离，不证明完整FTQ后端来源寿命。保留旧迟到奖惩四例及其48格分母，新组合独立报告。 四个真实匹配分支PC分别保存原件，当前方向被其他反馈反转后，旧有效纠错、旧基础一致与旧错误仍各按原资格处理；同/不同读取祖先及反向返回顺序分别验证，不把同一匹配PC的不同readPC误算成四个分支。

semantic_review.previous_title: Every useful address supports genuine provider updates and both saturation holds
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Require all 512 addresses in both tables, four useful update roles (increase, upper saturation hold, decrease, lower saturation hold) and serial/adjacent cadence: 8192 mandatory cross bins across 2048 provider contexts. Build each provider through genuine public prediction and training, retain base-agreement holds, and independently replay pipeline qualifiers, useful arithmetic and all 1024 cells without consuming actual internal state as the reference. Examine the entire matrix before reporting any existing BPU-UTAGE-007 obstruction. In this test's existing same-PC input profile, 768 lower high-address contexts have independently verified physical allocations but cannot supply matching eight-bit stored tags; retain its 3072 blocked cross bins as zero and raise only the specific provider-blocked exception after all contexts are checked. This does not prove those physical addresses globally unreachable with independent index/tag contexts (BPU-UTAGE-023). Incorrect prerequisites or any other mismatch must fail normally; a corrected implementation must pass the full same-PC matrix and trigger strict XPASS until the defect marker is removed. Do not fabricate provider metadata, waive blocked addresses or subtract native uncovered rows.

semantic_subrequirements.penalty: 错误 provider 按真实反馈顺序失去保护
semantic_subrequirements.upper-hold: 已达最强保护后继续奖励不绕回
semantic_subrequirements.lower-hold: 已无保护后继续惩罚不下溢
semantic_subrequirements.reverse-from-upper: 最强保护仍可被后续错误削弱
semantic_subrequirements.reverse-from-lower: 失去保护的身份可凭有效纠正重新获得保护
semantic_subrequirements.base-agreement-interior: 中间保护等级下与基础预测一致的正确反馈不取得保护更新资格
semantic_subrequirements.base-agreement-upper: 上界保护等级下与基础预测一致的正确反馈不取得保护更新资格
semantic_subrequirements.base-agreement-lower: 下界保护等级下与基础预测一致的正确反馈不取得保护更新资格

semantic_subrequirements.working-set-boundary-and-agreement: 大工作集中已到保护上界的身份继续正确纠正或与基础预测一致时，保护不绕回；方向置信度仍按自己的实际反馈演进
semantic_subrequirements.working-set-selective-recovery: 只向部分历史身份提供错误及恢复反馈时，仅这些身份先失去再恢复保护；同组未反馈身份和共享的短历史预测保持完整不变
semantic_subrequirements.delayed-original-correctness: 迟到反馈的奖惩依据原预测是否正确，不能被已经翻转的当前方向追溯改判
semantic_subrequirements.delayed-original-agreement: 迟到的原一致且正确反馈保持非零保护，但仍须在当前版本完成方向学习

semantic_requirements: 工作集跨越最近写缓冲多次周转后，各长历史身份继续独立累积方向置信度与替换保护
大工作集内的保护上界保持和基础预测一致性保持不阻断属于各身份的方向学习
选择性错误及恢复反馈只改变提供反馈的历史身份；未更新身份、共享短历史和全部原始快照保持

semantic_review.previous_title: Independent index/tag ancestors permit genuine high-address useful provider updates
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use one four-node high-index input-history geometry, not a bank/address sweep. Its earlier C-to-D index context selects lower address462, while the later D-to-A tag context uses low PC A and a representable full tag208. Add optional independent index PC/history to the existing staged lookup driver without changing legacy defaults or exposing clock edges in tests. In serial and adjacent feedback modes, allocate a real high-address provider, verify all index/fold/base/provider metadata, increase useful through saturation, preserve it on base agreement, decrease it through zero hold, and read back the lower counter through a distinct untouched upper context. Interleave adjacent lookups with one independently allocated low-row, different-PC negative neighbor; compare every response and actual acceptance/completion event, and preserve the neighbor after high-row updates. Derive every useful qualifier/effect from accepted genuine feedback and compare all1024 useful cells including neighbors. Require all20 semantic mode/contract bins and credit only the eight actual high-address update-role bins into the original8192-bin physical schema. Reject corrupted provider/tag/index metadata before training. No fabricated metadata, internal state writes, VPI or claim of full FTQ legality/global address coverage. Keep the separate same-PC tag-width defect requirement intact.

semantic_review.scenario_detail: Retain direct-training assertions and independent MicroBTB/MainBTB composition, with five source-qualified reached/checked obligations. Also compose autonomous MainBTB/TAGE learning from reset and independently owned path-history checkpoints, read snapshots, selectors and allocation state. Six further event obligations require actual short-provider learning, promotion retaining its alternate, Main-only feedback preserving TAGE, raw-provider S2 consumption, a qualified alternate S3 repair against an opposing independently learned Main base, and strong-provider retention. Check every defined public and accepted-input Main/TAGE metadata field before learning; actual provider, SRAM, history folds or component results never seed expected state. Source release is verification bookkeeping, not RTL FTQ commit. Cases express semantic outcomes; bounded model-based allocation admission belongs to the driver/environment, with no fixed settling delays or physical-bank enumeration. No new functional ID for strengthening an oracle. Other predictor combinations, arbitrary live trained enable transitions, call/return and full FTQ epoch legality remain unqualified composition profiles.

semantic_review.previous_title: Two history-distinct TAGE beats survive the same-bank read stall
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Prepare two independently trained provider cells for the same PC and branch position under different real PHR contexts. Queue both mispredicted feedback beats while a nonconditional prediction loop continuously reads the same TAGE bank. Both handles must remain pending while the prediction monitor observes the loop; after prediction reads stop, both beats must be accepted on adjacent cycles. Context-specific readback must show a longer-history provider allocated for the first context and the original second-context provider counter incremented, proving neither queued beat was lost or misassociated. Shared MainBTB metadata is intentionally stale across the two snapshots and is not used as the beat counter.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 两个handle被创建不等于硬件有两份义务，必须保留独立实际接受和消费。

semantic_review.previous_title: Integrated ITTAGE provider overrides a distinct MainBTB indirect target at S3
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Allocate an ITTAGE target provider through real BPU FTQ feedback for an indirect branch. Disable ITTAGE while changing only MainBTB's target, then check the disabled S2 target. Re-enable ITTAGE in the same redirect/history context and require the S2 MainBTB target to be corrected at S3 to the resident ITTAGE target, with matching provider metadata. This proves integrated ITTAGE connectivity and source priority rather than relying on standalone ITTAGE tests.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 静态同路径竞争不证明目录替换、并发服务或全部enable在途组合。

features.title: 嵌套调用的返回目标按存活调用年龄逐层弹出
features.description: 不同调用者嵌套，或一个外层调用进入同地址递归，随后真实返回逐次消耗原调用。 多个递归层同时保留未消费次数，末次间接调用以原检查点修正目标并重做一次。 每个return消费当前最年轻存活调用帧，不按目标值相同近似关联。 返回按存活调用LIFO展开；重复组全部消耗后切换到不同外层返回地址，不多弹、漏弹或继续使用内层地址。 内层完整组或拆组后的返回不消耗外层次数，跨层恢复各自原返回身份。 原有嵌套程序及精确8/9递归前缀使用真实S3来源，逐笔比较最终返回目标、有序退休及完整提交状态。 额外逐笔比较三层递归14/16次实际调用和同数返回、三次调用目标修正、每层退休后完整剩余提交状态。 未消耗的外层调用和原metadata保持，取消的年轻调用不退休；压缩表示不改变逻辑调用次数。 声明的嵌套及递归展开程序；不请求空栈或容量已淘汰调用的返回，不外推完整FTQ调度。 新增三层(3,2,8)/(3,2,10)有界寿命；不外推全部层数、物理槽位或完整后端执行。 接近提交容量时，两个相邻但不同调用点的递归层同时存活，分别保留较多或较少的未消费调用。 内层与外层的剩余返回次数独立；自然返回耗尽内层后，仍按外层自己的次数和返回身份继续展开。 以还留一组空间和恰好保留全部调用两种容量边界，交叉外层次数更多和内层次数更多；逐笔比较完整返回PC/目标、各层退休后的完整提交状态及最终sentinel。 近容量调用目标修正取消年轻后缀并只重做原调用一次，不能串用相邻递归层计数，也不能丢失仍存活的外层调用。 仅覆盖声明的容量内逻辑调用树；不返回已淘汰调用，不按栈槽枚举，不外推任意深度或完整FTQ执行。

semantic_review.previous_title: Two nested calls and returns preserve integrated RAS LIFO target order
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Pretrain two direct calls and two indirect returns while RAS is disabled, with each return's MainBTB target deliberately wrong. Re-enable RAS and follow a two-level call path. Require both calls' MainBTB corrections to reach their callees; for each return, require the matched S2 correction to expose the wrong static MainBTB target and the same transaction's S3 correction to select the appropriate LIFO return address. This checks integrated speculative RAS state across two distinct frames rather than relying on standalone RAS tests or a single call-return pair.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 两层LIFO不自动证明全部主栈/推测队列容量和恢复寿命。

semantic_review.previous_title: Captured-metadata PHR recovery across the reset-reachable even-pointer orbit
semantic_review.scenario_detail: After an enabled cold-start lookup, recover using genuinely observed, causally associated S3 metadata. For each flowing and backpressured cadence exercise both pointer flags, all 26 even pointer values, and taken/not-taken with distinct branch PC and recovery target. Compare all 52 physical history cells, all 76 folded-history registers, pointer/flag, pending state, and public metadata every cycle using an independent model. Keep all 52 pointer values in the coverage cross: the 208 unqualified odd-pointer bins across both cadences remain zero, not waived; this requirement does not prove global FTQ metadata parity.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: PHR输入切点独立于实际存储状态，但不是整个预测方向的自主参考；物理指针全遍历不是独立语义要求。

semantic_requirements: 较老执行恢复与年轻中级修正实际同拍竞争时，只恢复原执行历史、取消年轻工作，并由新消费者持有正确检查点；先完成年轻修正的串行对照语义一致。
两个不同真实原预测按年轻到更老顺序连续接纳恢复时，第二份更老来源仍存活；比较中间及最终历史、原迭代、完整输入与新公开消费者，禁止年轻前缀复活、合并两份结果或借用当前计数。

semantic_review.scenario_detail: Train a genuine conditional MainBTB entry, then resolve not-taken while MicroBTB still predicts taken. Associate the original S1 token through actual fire/flush controls; compare restoration of its historical pointer and low bits, pending not-taken state, all physical cells and fold registers. Require prediction.ready low at the actual correction in the backpressured case, while the older accepted token still reaches S3 metadata.

semantic_review.previous_title: Real forward/backward conditional histories select, train and read back all SC tables
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use normal public feedback and genuine cold checkpoints to install forward/backward conditional prefixes and an unconditional target jump in both banks. Preserve independently verified zero path history while actual target metadata has commonHR-valid, GHR=1, BW=0/1 and IMLI=0. The existing component CommonHR model checks global GHR/BW/valid state, then target indices, two adjacent complete feedbacks, all five SC tables' SRAM/shadow updates and public decisions with unchanged providers; it consumes observed component inputs and is not an autonomous SC golden. Additionally an independent conditional-event history model composed with autonomous Main/Micro/path sources qualifies the later-direct control for original nonzero-history not-taken recovery: only the earlier executed conditional appends zero, internal committed state and a separate valid public consumer retain254/14, and nonconditional Main hits do not become history bits. This public-only profile does not bind internal GHR/BW. The later-conditional violation is separately required by094, not waived by this control. The40 original bins and these bounded controls do not claim all history bits/indices, arbitrary delayed S0 queue selection, autonomous IMLI or SC source composition, deep dirty/clean lifecycles, SC-used eligibility, full overwrite, prediction overlap or global FTQ legality.

semantic_review.previous_title: Natural failed allocations reach real useful aging without internal state injection

Require an actual aging pulse and compare the numeric counter and all1024 useful values, lower decrement and upper halving, while preserving all preceding PHR/index/SRAM/shadow/policy checks. The full56 operation-bin denominator remains visible; missing nonzero aging banks, all useful strengths, same-cycle alloc/update-age overlap and full FTQ are not claimed.

features.description: 实际S3调用/返回形成相配metadata，并以正常公开提交请求有序退休。 每份退休属于其原推测调用/返回及前态，不属于当前栈顶碰巧相同的地址。 提交组按嵌套调用LIFO演进，每次退休只更新一次，流水线排空后无残余义务。 关联真实S3来源和实际接纳，逐次比较所有提交组、指针、PHR与公开返回。 未消费老调用和原metadata保持，不以采样DUT状态建立期望栈。 两个嵌套调用/返回的集成退休切点；不是任意分支发现或全FTQ调度证明。

semantic_review.previous_title: Genuine S3 metadata drives integrated nested call and return retirement
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Associate actual S3 speculation with its coherent public metadata, drive ordered public commit requests through the reusable retirement driver and observe next registered stack updates. From genuine reset compare all eight committed stack entries, pointers and full PHR for two nested calls/returns, exact accepted payloads, one update per commit and complete drain. Never fabricate SSP/tosw or seed from DUT state.

semantic_review.previous_title: Integrated retirement traverses all committed stack slots and wraps the sentinel

Repeated-address counters, empty/stale-SSP recovery and a full speculative queue are separate requirements.

semantic_review.previous_title: Original-source early providers overrule opposite bases and learn usefulness in both directions
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Retain the genuine high-index four-node program, lower index462/tag208 ancestry, same-ABTB-index200 alias, full shadow/useful/PHR/counter/replacement/SRAM checks, all ten original contract bins and all four useful roles. Additionally qualify autonomous Main/Ahead/MicroTAGE composition from ordinary discoveries and reset-owned full history. Learn a stable negative provider; bias the same complete Ahead owner positive through a distinct steady MicroTAGE history without modifying the protected entry/useful value. Change Main alone back to negative with fast learners disabled, then require a real original-source NT provider to overrule a positive base at S1, select the later direct jump, agree with independent Main without repair, and cause a physically confirmed useful increase one comparison boundary after the source-qualified learning effect. For the opposite direction, freeze the independently learned and actually confirmed positive seed pool BEFORE driving the return; preserve every declared entry/useful value while learning a negative shared base through another history and changing Main alone positive. Honor independent highest-provider priority; require a fresh named public T consumer from that declared pool to select the earlier conditional over the negative base without repair and own its own useful increase, confirmed at the following complete actual comparison. Keep both original learning snapshots immutable and release owners only after closure. Compare all1024 useful cells from independent state; disabled naked hit bits are not valid prediction responses. Twenty reached/checked obligations include prerequisites shared with the fourteen-rule NT program, not twenty new functions. Explicit preverified redirect ownership resolves numeric checkpoint aliases without guessing histories or claiming complete FTQ lifetime. No bank/set enumeration, fabricated DUT metadata, internal writes, VPI, tag truncation or all-predictor composition claim. The representative autonomous programs complement rather than replace the high-index lower-provider test.

short_path_retention_evidence.scope: 选定最早/最新短路径实际获得保护，并在方向下界和保护上界保持；其余路径及实际SRAM独立保留。

semantic_requirements: 保护达到上、下界后，同向合格反馈保持且不回绕，反向反馈仍可恢复；必须按真实前态和实际消费者证明，不能仅凭increase/decrease控制角色分类。
同一原provider保护达到3后，真实正确纠正仍保持3；其后真实错误指导可使保护降至2，原记录仍可被fresh查询消费。
同一原provider自然失去保护至0后，继续收到错误指导仍保持0；真实正确纠正随后可使保护恢复到1。
较长历史未匹配时，原短表provider仍按自己的真实指导完成保护边界保持与恢复；短表错误同时允许更长表分配时，二者必须按同一前态分别正确，不能被额外年轻学习或另一个更长provider冒充。
原T记录独立证明保护边界与恢复：T正确纠正NT base才是奖励，与T base一致的正确指导不得增加保护；错误造成的方向变化仍属于原记录，只有再次形成合格T纠正及新消费者才可证明T极性恢复。短表T错误允许长表分配时，应按NT指导独立确认新长记录，不能借用相反极性结果。

T长记录按正常分配保护2独立证明边界，不能套用短表初值1或换成长表任意T命中。最长provider错误仍应更新原记录并只记一次无更长候选失败，不向短表反向分配；计数、保护变化与原长消费者由独立原来源共同确认。先用原短记录自己的错误指导释放其保护，证明短表实际可用仍不能反向分配；原长连续错误之后，新短消费者还须验证未参与的原短身份、方向和零保护保留。另行证明原长方向4→3成为NT、NT错误3→4恢复T时保护仍为0，只有随后真实T纠正才使保护0→1；这五次原长错误各拥有一次无更长候选失败，不能把方向恢复误算为保护奖励。
真实短历史来源在保护边界接受与base一致的正确指导后，方向仍学习、后续奖惩仍生效：下界NT3/0→NT2/0后，经两个真实错误恢复T4/0，再由有效纠正到T5/1；上界T7/3中性保持后，错误仍到T6/2。每个声明阶段必须由确切S1原来源、完整S3收据、实际FastTrain效果及下一完整状态确认配对，准备指导不得冒领；最终新消费者和原快照/全部保护单元共同闭环。

semantic_review.previous_title: Real ITTAGE region capacity, full-table reuse and pointer replacement preserve associated targets
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Use21 genuine zero-history public contexts in one region-directory capacity lifecycle: one PC-region bypass,16 foreign-region fills, one existing-region reuse while free entries remain, one reuse at full occupancy and two PLRU replacements. Existing-region reuse must take priority over free-entry selection; only a full directory with no match replaces a victim. Capture genuine cold checkpoints once per aligned source and preserve complete metadata; associate actual accepted feedback, independently classified prestate, exact region write and next complete16-entry state. PC-region bypass checked credit waits for no directory effect and its complete public consumer. Prediction consumption is a separate event family: PC-region target, retained resident pointer and old pointer redecoded after replacement each require complete public metadata and exact associated final S3 pc/target/taken/position. Recheck every resident after every allocation, preserving full reset-derived52-bit PHR, planned zero-history inputs, all directory read/update ports including same-cycle write bypass, full state and drained effects. Export reached/checked events at these real boundaries, not reset, scenario order or drain checklist labels. The public predictor allocation proposal is an explicit input; no full predictor hashing/SRAM reference, full FTQ legality or cross-region zero-confidence retarget correctness claim. The ordinary-failing retarget diagnostic remains open and earns no credit. No bank/set sweep, internal writes, VPI, waveform/per-cycle JSON, new XFAIL or removed native denominators.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 容量所需16居民不是bank扫点；零置信跨区域retarget的既有普通FAIL不能由目录控制PASS关闭。

semantic_requirements: MRAS.RETURN.PAIR_YOUNGEST_PUSH
MRAS.RETURN.FORWARD_SURVIVING_SOURCE

semantic_review.previous_title: An accepted early RETURN pairs by age and forwards the surviving MicroRAS stack source
semantic_review.scenario_detail: With no redirect or S2/S3 correction taking priority, an actual accepted S1 RETURN pairs with the youngest pending push. If S2 and S3 both contain pushes, pair the RETURN with S2 and forward the older S3 return address. If S2 is neutral and only S3 pushes, pair with S3 and use the main speculative RAS top input. Associate the event with the genuine public early prediction and its exact final metadata. Compare the next complete nine-register MicroRAS state and output from reset-derived expectations, and preserve full PHR, ordered genuine retirement, committed cells and drain checks. Event reachability and checked effects are distinct measurements; reset, checking scope, instruction counts and drain are not peer event bins. No synthetic stage control, fabricated metadata, internal writes, VPI or bank/set sweep. Main speculative RAS top remains an explicit module input, not an independent complete main-stack or FTQ model.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 到达与下一状态检查分开，调用数量或排空步骤不能当同级功能事件覆盖。

semantic_review.previous_title: A neutral S2 correction cancels younger MicroRAS operations while preserving the older CALL effect
semantic_review.scenario_detail: An actual advancing neutral S2 correction, without redirect or S3 correction taking priority, supersedes the concurrently accepted younger S1 CALL or RETURN but preserves the older pending S3 CALL effect. The next MicroRAS output must forward that older return address, and neither younger operation may survive in pending state, final public metadata or the main RAS speculative channel. Associate the real public S2 correction with the original neutral prediction, the exact older S3 ancestor and younger decoded operation, then compare the next complete nine-register state and output against reset-derived expectations. Preserve every intended public target, complete PHR, ordered genuine retirement, committed cells and drained effects. CALL and RETURN are semantic cancellation contexts, not a physical matrix. Reached and checked events are separate; no fabricated metadata, stage pins, internal writes, VPI or new XFAIL. No independent complete main speculative stack or FTQ legality claim.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: MicroRAS切点和主栈观察不能被夸大为全主栈自主历史或全FTQ合法性证明。

semantic_review.previous_title: Qualified SC threshold votes commit inclusively or reject the whole out-of-range delta
semantic_review.scenario_detail: An actually accepted, enabled public training payload supplies the qualified branch votes of its T1 threshold update. For each threshold way aggregate all participating increments and decrements before applying the custom range: a candidate in640..5040, including either endpoint, commits; an out-of-range candidate preserves the entire prior value rather than clamping. Inward updates remain effective after rejection and at either endpoint. All nonparticipating ways retain their prior values. Associate the original accepted payload, T1 controls and next observed committed register vector; input presentation or candidate arithmetic alone is not completion. Event reachability and checked effects are reported separately. Genuine prediction metadata and independent reset-derived state are required; no physical bank/set sweep, internal writes, VPI, independent IMLI or full FTQ legality claim.

semantic_review.previous_title: Qualified opposed SC votes cancel before custom boundary filtering
semantic_review.scenario_detail: Two distinct conditional branches from the same genuinely accepted prediction contribute opposite threshold votes to the same way. Resolve their net delta before the custom range decision, so the threshold remains unchanged in the interior and at either endpoint; sequential per-branch range filtering is not equivalent. Use a reachable first-not-taken, last-taken feedback vector, preserving genuine unmodified metadata. Check the exact accepted source, aggregate T1 vote effect, next committed complete threshold vector and other-way isolation. This is distinct from an unqualified no-op, saturation hold or range rejection. Reuse the boundary workload rather than adding a physical matrix; all existing SRAM/shadow/PHR/public-output checks remain required. No full FTQ legality or independent IMLI claim.

semantic_review.previous_title: Qualified weak-provider disagreement trains and consumes the integrated TAGE selector
semantic_review.scenario_detail: An actual enabled conditional feedback with a genuine MainBTB owner and weak TAGE provider trains its provider-table/alternate-confidence selector only when provider and alternate/base disagree. Alternate-correct contributes an increment and provider-correct a decrement; aggregate the participating votes and saturate the five-bit result. Strong providers and agreeing sources do not train the selector. Associate the exact original prediction, accepted full public payload, T2 metadata/read mode, independently derived T3 qualifiers/votes and next committed eight-register vector from reset. Provider-table identity and alternate/base confidence must route the qualified vote to the correct one of eight logical selectors and leave every other selector unchanged. Reuse the real eight-tag candidate-capacity preparation with one weak and one strong MainBTB base per provider table to check all eight routing objects, without adding physical bank/set enumeration or new aging scenarios. Preserve the original single-key saturation and actual prediction-consumption checks: fresh weak-provider predictions must consume the independent selector sign to choose provider or alternate. Training SRAM read operands are explicit checked inputs for fresh-source projection, not an independently reconstructed full TAGE SRAM model; stale/overlapping metadata and complete FTQ legality remain outside the claim. Useful aging itself is covered separately by BPU-INT-073. No internal writes, VPI, fabricated metadata or new XFAIL.
semantic_review.evidence_limits: 单key饱和与八路由不自动证明两端多票净聚合；旧中间值抵消不能替代该子义务。
